source_page_reviewed.publisher: City of Apache Junction via official Legistar October 6, 2026 Council agenda attachments

findings.statement: The city council agenda's Chapter 17 attachment includes §17-1-3 GENERAL OPERATION governing ALPR use; it is the attachment text, not an independently authenticated final signed chapter.

Section 17-1-4(C) of the city's three-page Chapter 17 council agenda attachment says specified ALPR vehicle data shall be collected and stored for 30 consecutive calendar days. This is written attachment language, not independently verified current system settings.

Section 17-1-4(D) of the Chapter 17 council agenda attachment permits sharing with other cities, towns or counties with supervisor preapproval, subject to authorization, credentials, permissions and documentation requirements. No actual reciprocal sharing access is established.

Section 17-1-5 of the Chapter 17 council agenda attachment calls for monthly police department ALPR log/user audits and a city employee outside the police department to inspect the audit's accuracy. This does not verify that audits occurred.

source_page_reviewed.limitations: Agenda attachment is original government PDF evidence of proposed or before-Council chapter wording. The City Clerk's separate scanned adopted Ordinance 1579 has not been visually compared to the chapter or page-reviewed; final enacted chapter wording, effective date, compliance and live practice are not independently established.

source_page_reviewed.publisher: City of Apache Junction via official Legistar October 6, 2026 Council agenda attachments

findings.statement: The original pre-meeting ordinance attachment proposes adopting by reference a separately filed Chapter 17 on automated license plate readers. This page documents the proposal wording; it cannot verify the final enacted attachment.

The official pre-meeting ordinance attachment's page 3 retains unfilled adoption-date and mayoral signature placeholders. Its presence on the agenda is not proof that this particular PDF was executed.

source_page_reviewed.limitations: This is the unsigned council agenda attachment and must not be mistaken for the separately published City Clerk adopted ordinance. Actual adoption is independently supported by the Clerk's official HTML register. Final signed text/effective date remain held pending visual source comparison.

agency_self_disclosure.limitations: Government graphic is a dated schematic with directional markers, proposed points, relocation and offline symbols. These cannot be promoted to individually verified coordinate pins without geospatial source validation; published 30 devices is a departmental aggregate claim, not 30 verified operating devices.

findings.statement: The separate three-page City Clerk original identifies Ordinance 1579 amending city code Volume I through a new Chapter 17 on automated license plate readers and penalties; the original scanned paper, not the unsigned Council agenda draft, was visually reviewed.

Section I of the signed City Clerk original adopts by reference the separately filed document titled '2026 Amendments to the Apache Junction City Code, Volume I, Chapter 17: Automated License Plate Readers,' made a public record by Resolution 26-43. The full final filed chapter must be separately authenticated before asserting that its text equals the earlier Council attachment.

The City Clerk's visually inspected page 3 records passage and signing October 6, 2026, the mayoral signature and City Clerk's attestation, and Section IV's Class 1 misdemeanor penalty for violations of the adopted provisions. No legal-effective date is separately established.

signed_original_visually_reviewed.limitations: All three scanned City Clerk pages were visually examined against the pinned SHA-256 original. This verifies a signed, clerk-attested adopted ordinance, NOT a separately established legal-effective date, authenticated matching final Chapter 17 text, confirmed ALPR configuration or actual enforcement/compliance.
